visualReview.notes: Inspected seven final portable frames, full shared aerial and the local reference originals. Seven original radial cellblock roofs, later infill wings, low hub, separate crenellated gatehouse and enclosing perimeter remain distinct. Roof normals and occluded gatehouse windows were corrected before final captures. Fine decay, exact infill roofs and interior cells remain outside the stated scope.

fidelityReview.scope: Surviving radial prison exterior, later cellblocks, central hub, Fairmount Avenue gatehouse and perimeter; detailed ruin fabric and interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Accepted original medium-fi surviving prison exterior. The local 1855 lithograph misleadingly named aerial was excluded from current form evidence. Inspected Qualla watchtower/masonry and courtyard photographs, museum visitor plan, HABS roof/gatehouse views and overhead aerial establish the exterior relationships. Roof heights, narrow cell openings, skylight rhythm, service wings, northeast corner and weathering are generalized; archival views do not establish a precise 2026 condition inventory. Interiors, yard fixtures and surrounding city are omitted. Research images are not embedded or redistributed.

limitations: Original medium-fi surviving exterior from local Qualla masonry/courtyard photographs, generalized current footprints, museum map and inspected archival HABS exterior views; not a measured survey or an exact 2026 condition inventory.

Seven original radial wings, later infill and separate gatehouse are differentiated. Detailed decay, exact skylight counts, hidden roof joins, smaller yard partitions and service fixtures are generalized.
The 1855 hero lithograph is rejected as current form evidence; its historic central turret and rows of separate exercise yards are not restored.

Three mapped corner controls establish the perimeter; northeast corner closure, roof heights and unseen rear details remain photographic interpretations. Ground contact uses coarse host terrain, not surveyed pavement levels.
No interiors, surrounding streets, temporary visitor attractions or reference-photo textures are included. Research images remain local and are not embedded in runtime packs.
